title: config/llm/models.yaml
description: Logical LLM routes mapped to gateway model names. Used by all LLM users and the gateway setup. Contract version 0.5.0.

routes.description: Route id (chat-default, chat-alt, chat-local, embed-default, embed-local, ...) -> gateway model name (provider/model).

openrouterProviders.description: OpenRouter model (the route value without the openrouter/ prefix) -> upstream provider. llm-replay sends it as provider.order with allow_fallbacks=false.
